script.problem: It has 3 sentences. A meaning is 1 or 2 sentences.

terra.problem: “Spiritually poor” repeats the idiom without explaining it. The meaning could say that these people recognize their need and know they cannot help themselves. Also, “They don't mean people who are poor in money” could wrongly suggest that poor people are excluded; Gill says many are among them. The claim that they have “nothing good of their own to give God” is not stated in the notes.
